title: Exactness of raw truncation maps for arbitrary derived-category instances
statement: theorem truncation_raw_exact {A : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v₁} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} A] {B : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} B] [Abelian B] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v₂} B] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} B] (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] (K : CochainComplex.Plus A) : let g : ∀ p q : ℤ, TruncationCouple.D F K p q ⟶ TruncationCouple.E F K (p + (0 : ℕ)) (q - (0 : ℕ)) := fun p q ↦ TruncationCouple.g F K p q ≫ eqToHom (by simp) (∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ w : TruncationCouple.f F K p q ≫ TruncationCouple.alpha F K (p + 2) (q - 1) = 0, (ShortComplex.mk _ _ w).Exact) ∧ (∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ w : g p q ≫ TruncationCouple.f F K (p + (0 : ℕ)) (q - (0 : ℕ)) = 0, (ShortComplex.mk _ _ w).Exact) ∧ (∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ w : TruncationCouple.alpha F K p q ≫ g (p - 1) (q + 1) = 0, (ShortComplex.mk _ _ w).Exact)

source.place: proof, step 1; Lean refinement with the same objects and canonical maps

proof.text:
The triangle tau<=q-1 K -> tau<=q K -> H^q(K)[-q] with the boundary
chosen by `TruncationCouple.existsUnique_boundary` is distinguished. Apply the
triangulated right derived functor and its homology sequence. Transport exactness
across the three bridge isomorphisms. The g-f and f-alpha pairs use the triangle at q, in total degrees p+q
and p+q+1 respectively; the alpha-g pair uses the triangle at q+1, in total
degree p+q.
The index identities preserve total degree, and transport of exact short complexes
preserves both their zero composites and their image-equals-kernel condition.
